text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I gave your present to your classmate, 
Cheval. I told them it was something I 
borrowed, but make no mistake, it's 
definitely your present.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Don't hold back! I'll answer anything.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I might just be overthinking it, 
but... it felt like it was done really 
secretly."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Crown-san always carries herself with such 
dignity... so it's, well, kind of 
surprising.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You don't like big, flashy things, do you, 
Cheval? I wanted to match your style.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
For your present, I picked a translated 
novel I recommend. I read it in the 
original language, and it was so 
insightful!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure someone as wise as you will love 
it. If you'd like, I'd love to discuss our 
thoughts on it afterwards.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... thank you. Um, well then... Once I 
finish reading it, I might tell you... no, 
yeah. ...I will tell you.
